parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Experiment 1
Use a measuring cylinder to pour 25cm of aqueous copper(II) sulfate into the polystyrene
cup provided. Put the polystyrene cup into a 250cm beaker for support. Measure the initial
temperature of the solution and then the temperature after 30 seconds and 60 seconds. Record
your results in the table.
At 60 seconds add all of the iron to the aqueous copper(II) sulfate and stir the mixture
continuously with the thermometer.
Measure the temperature of the mixture every 30 seconds for 300 seconds (5 minutes). Record
your results in the table.

Experiment 2
Empty the polystyrene cup and rinse it with water.
Use a measuring cylinder to pour 25cm of aqueous copper(II) sulfate into the polystyrene
cup. Put the polystyrene cup into a 250cm beaker for support. Measure the initial temperature
of the solution and then the temperature after 30 seconds and 60 seconds. Record your results
in the table.
At 60 seconds add all of the magnesium to the aqueous copper(II) sulfate and stir the mixture
continuously with the thermometer.
Measure the temperature of the mixture every 30 seconds for 300 seconds (5 minutes). Record
your results in the table.

text: You are going to investigate what happens when two different metals, iron and magnesium, react
with aqueous copper(II) sulfate.
Read all the instructions carefully before starting the experiments.
Instructions
You are going to carry out two experiments.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Divide solution Q into four equal portions in four test-tubes. Carry out the following tests.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Use pH indicator paper to measure the pH of the first portion of solution Q.
pH ______

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Add a 2cm strip of magnesium ribbon to the second portion of solution Q. Test the gas
given off.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Add a spatula measure of sodium carbonate to the third portion of solution Q. Test the gas
given off.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text:
Add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of aqueous barium nitrate to the fourth
portion of solution Q.
Record your observations.

text: You are provided with two solutions, solution Q and solution R.
Carry out the following tests on solution Q and solution R, recording all of your observations at each
stage.
